name: reg_rename
help: Renames a registry key or value on a local or remote host
long_help:
Usage: reg_rename <hostname> <hive> <path> <oldname> <newname> <iskey>

Parameters:
  hostname: Target hostname (e.g. WIN-SRV or \\\\WIN-SRV). Use empty string "" for local host.
  hive:     Registry hive (0=HKCR, 1=HKCU, 2=HKLM, 3=HKU, 4=HKCU_LOCAL_IMP)
  path:     Registry path (e.g. Software\\MyKey)
  oldname:  Old value name to rename. Use empty string "" if renaming the key itself.
  newname:  New name for the registry key or value.
  iskey:    1 to rename a registry key, 0 to rename a registry value.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target hostname (e.g. WIN-SRV or \\\\WIN-SRV). Use empty string "" for local host.
